# BINO

> Building Intelligence & Operations — smart operational memory for every building.

BINO is not a generic ticketing system. It learns from ticket history, equipment, vendors, costs, and resolution times; recommends the right worker or vendor; detects recurring failures; alerts on SLA risk; and proves time and money saved for the management company.

## North-star product metrics

1. Time to assignment
2. Time to resolution
3. Recurring-failure rate
4. Maintenance cost per building
5. % of tickets handled without manager intervention
